note: Early publications establishing biallelic NAV3 variants and OMIM #621182 describe isolated probands or small consanguineous cohorts (e.g., 1 to 5 patients), supporting small-cohort ascertainment bias.

evidence.text: The authors report five patients from three unrelated consanguineous families segregating autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with biallelic truncating variants in NAV3.

source.title: Further evidence of biallelic NAV3 variants associated with recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with dysmorphism, developmental delay, intellectual disability …
source.quote: Here, we report five patients from three unrelated consanguineous families segregating autosomal recessive NDD.

evidence.text: The initial discovery linking biallelic NAV3 variants to autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder identified a homozygous frameshift variant in a single Saudi proband.

source.title: Mutated neuron navigator 3 as a candidate gene for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: We describe a Saudi proband presenting a complex recessive neurodevelopmental disorder (NDD)... For the time, we associate a bi-allelic variant in the NAV3 gene causing NDD in humans.
